description: The Zenodo provider republishes a Viet Nam biomass atlas identified as a 2018 World Bank and ESMAP mapping product, with an Energydata.info source address. The public archive is about 90 MB and Zenodo labels it CC BY 4.0. Biomass resource maps can set candidate fuel-supply areas and transport distances in bioenergy or industrial-heat infrastructure simulations. The resource is a mapped potential, not an observed annual fuel delivery or a guaranteed sustainable harvest. The landing page gives no biomass classes, mass units, spatial resolution, resource year or methodology beyond the atlas citation. Those details and upstream source rights should be verified before turning map cells into energy supply. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this named Viet Nam atlas. The ZIP was not downloaded, so its raster or vector formats, legends and actual potential values remain unverified.
name: Biomass Atlas of VIetnam (2018)
notes: G6 item G6-2280. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
